SELECT
CR.ROOM_ID, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CR.ROOM_DESCRIPTION, CR.CREATED_BY, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.STATUS, CR.MAX_MEMBER, CR.IS_DEFAULT,
B.BUSINESS_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM WHERE CRM.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID ) MEMBER_COUNT
FROM CHAT_ROOM CR
LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON CR.CREATED_BY = B.BUSINESS_NO
WHERE CR.STATUS='ACTIVE'
ORDER BY CR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT
CR.ROOM_ID, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CR.ROOM_DESCRIPTION, CR.CREATED_BY, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.STATUS, CR.MAX_MEMBER, CR.IS_DEFAULT,
B.BUSINESS_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER T WHERE T.ROOM_ID=CR.ROOM_ID ) MEMBER_COUNT
FROM CHAT_ROOM CR
JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM ON CR.ROOM_ID=CRM.ROOM_ID
LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON CR.CREATED_BY=B.BUSINESS_NO
WHERE CRM.BUSINESS_NO=#{businessNo}
AND CR.STATUS='ACTIVE'
ORDER BY CR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT
CR.ROOM_ID, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, CR.ROOM_DESCRIPTION, CR.CREATED_BY, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.STATUS, CR.MAX_MEMBER, CR.IS_DEFAULT,
B.BUSINESS_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM WHERE CRM.ROOM_ID=CR.ROOM_ID ) MEMBER_COUNT
FROM CHAT_ROOM CR
LEFT JOIN BUSINESS B ON CR.CREATED_BY=B.BUSINESS_NO
WHERE CR.ROOM_ID=#{roomId}
